messages.content: Use only these exact declared semantic outcome and output-port identifiers: complete=main.result. On every write_file call, set outcome_id to the exact name before '=' and output_port_id to one exact port after '='; never substitute internal port_* handles. The content field carries serialized JSON bytes, so a text result must include JSON string quotes inside content. A timed-out or nonzero-exit workspace action remains immutable evidence. Account for it accurately when deciding what to do next; Registry records the fact but does not impose a retry or reserved-comment policy on completion. After all products are registered, call complete_interaction as the final tool call.
Complete the exact registered request using only the declared tools.
